chunks: And by this isnad, he said: Al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) said:
There is not one foot that hastens to the Friday prayer except that Allah forbids its body from the Fire.

key_terms.الجمعة: Friday prayer (Jumu'ah) — the obligatory congregational Friday noon prayer
key_terms.النار: the Fire (Hellfire) — the eschatological punishment of Hell
key_terms.حرم: forbids/makes forbidden — Allah's prohibition of the Fire from touching that person's body
key_terms.قدم: foot/step — used figuratively to represent the whole person who goes to Jumu'ah

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the reward for attending Friday prayer?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) conveys a promise of divine protection from Hellfire for those who attend Friday prayer (Jumu'ah). The hadith uses the metaphor of the 'foot that hastens' to Friday prayer to emphasize the meritorious act of actively proceeding to congregational worship. This teaching was transmitted in al-Amali of Sheikh al-Saduq, encouraging the Shia community to be diligent in attending Jumu'ah as a path to salvation.
